stable.message: No stable release yet. Please use beta or dev.

beta.name: rasqberry-beta-2026-10-10
highlights: After an update, "What's new" opens once, and the update offer shows it before you install
Your own extras after an update: root-owned scripts in /data/rasqberry/after-update.d/ run once on the new system
Fun with Quantum works offline on the Pi, with three new games: The CHSH Game, The Quantum Prisoner's Dilemma and GHZ on Real Quantum Devices
Workshop Server: doQumentation code runs on the Pi, also without the internet
Demo Loop can start at login and now shows Quantum Fractals too
Touchscreens: Raspberry Pi OS's own on-screen keyboard is back and pops up in text fields, also for the Wi-Fi password
Updates keep more: Home Connect settings, the right clock, and the taskbar badge; the badge says "being checked" until the new system is confirmed
Feedback by GitHub or e-mail (info@rasqberry.org), no GitHub account needed
traQmania is now racetraQ (v0.3.0, with a German UI); an existing install moves over
Quantum Lab and Quantum Mixer start from tested images, downloads show realistic times, Ctrl+C during any Docker download stops cleanly, and fewer false "no internet" messages at a demo's first start

dev.name: rasqberry-development-2026-11-14-115923
